name: RENAISSANCERE HOLDINGS LTD
summary: RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd. is a global provider of reinsurance and insurance. The company offers a range of products and services to help clients manage risks, including property, casualty, and specialty lines of business, with headquarters in Pembroke, Bermuda. They utilize their expertise in underwriting, risk management, and capital management to deliver innovative solutions to insurers and reinsurers worldwide.
